evidence.claim: EffRx sviluppa e commercializza farmaci su prescrizione per malattie endocrine e metaboliche rare e muscoloscheletriche in Europa e Svizzera.
evidence.quote: EffRx Pharmaceuticals is a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company focused on the late-stage development and commercialization of prescription medications for rare endocrine and metabolic disorders as well as musculoskeletal diseases. || EffRx Pharmaceuticals is a lean and agile, integrated, market-oriented biopharmaceutical company focused on niche therapeutics in Europe and in Switzerland.
